title: Polling monitor for superset-devin (manual trigger; webhook removed)
body:
## Summary
Turns the orchestrator into a **self-standing polling monitor**: it polls the GitHub API for a target repo (`royendo/superset-devin` by default) on an interval and starts a Devin remediation session for each new open issue carrying a trigger label. No public URL / webhook needed — just run the server. The legacy GitHub **webhook receiver was removed** to keep the repo simple; the dashboard, metrics, SQLite store and simulation mode are all kept.

Two ways to **manually trigger** a scan:
- `POST /poll/run` → JSON summary `{scanned, eligible, triggered, duplicate, errors, triggered_tasks}`
- press **`s`** in the server terminal (cbreak listener; auto-disabled when stdin isn't a TTY)

### What changed
- **`app/issues.py`** (new): `IssueSourceProtocol` with `GitHubIssueSource` (`GET /repos/{repo}/issues?state=open`, skips PRs, optional `GITHUB_TOKEN`) and `SimulatedIssueSource` (fixed eligible set for offline demos). `build_issue_source()` picks based on mode.
- **`app/keyboard.py`** (new): `KeyboardTrigger` — single-key shortcut bound to `IssuePoller.scan_now`.
- **`app/poller.py`**: new `IssuePoller` (scans on startup + every `ISSUE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS`; `scan_now()` serialised by a lock) alongside the existing session-reconciliation `PollingWorker`.
- **`app/orchestrator.py`**: extracted shared `_trigger(issue)` core; added `scan_open_issues(source) -> ScanResult`. `process_issue` simplified to `process_issue(issue)` (label-only eligibility).
- **`app/github.py`**: removed `verify_signature` / `parse_issue_payload` / `is_eligible` (webhook machinery); kept `has_trigger_label` + `build_prompt`.
- **`app/main.py`**: removed `POST /webhooks/github`; added `POST /poll/run`; `/health` now reports `monitored_repo`. Wires source/poller/keyboard into `lifespan`. `ISSUE_POLLING_ENABLED=false` disables the timer (manual-only).
- **`app/config.py`**: added `github_repo` / `github_token` / `github_api_base` / `issue_polling_enabled` / `issue_poll_interval_seconds`; removed `github_webhook_secret`.
- Docs/config: README, `.env.example`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`.

Dedupe is by `repo + issue number`, so repeated scans never start a second session for the same issue.

### Notes
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` is only used to *read* issues — a fine-grained PAT scoped to the repo with **Issues: Read-only** is sufficient (optional for public repos). Devin opens the actual PRs via the Devin↔GitHub integration.
- Verified locally: `ruff`, `mypy --strict`, `pytest` (9 tests) pass. Runtime smoke test (simulation) confirmed startup auto-scan, `POST /poll/run` dedupe, the `s` shortcut, session reconciliation, the dashboard, and that `/webhooks/github` now returns 404.

### Test plan
```bash
make install && make run-sim     # monitor auto-discovers synthetic issues
curl -X POST localhost:8000/poll/run   # manual scan (dedupes on re-run)
# press 's' in the server terminal to scan now
open http://localhost:8000/dashboard
```

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/514babc6b2b84961810172877e754c52
Requested by: @royendo
